Name: MARTIAL TRAINING
Main Effect:
You learn a number of Novice Martial Moves equal to 2 + your Rank in Colossus, and you can use them with Two-Handed Weapons.

Whenever you take a long rest, you can use your long rest action to change any number of learned Martial Moves.

At Rank 2, you can learn Adept Martial Moves, and at Rank 3, you gain access to Master Martial Moves.

Name: GIANT SLAYER
Main Effect: When you attack with a Colosal Weapon, the attack is made with advantage.

Name: COLOSSAL FORCE
Main Effect: Your Two-Handed Weapon Attacks are Elevated by 1.

Name: PRACTICED MOVES
Main Effect: When you make a Weapon Attack as a reaction, you can use a Martial Move with it, and that Martial Move costs no Action Points.

Name: PERFECT TECHNIQUE
Main Effect:
You can now use two Martial Moves on the same Two-Handed Weapon Attack.

Each Martial Move on the attack Empowers its damage by 1.

Name: MARTIAL SWIFTNESS
Main Effect: Your Martial Moves no longer cost Action Points.
